items.name: learning-plan
items.title: Learning Plan
items.description: Turn a topic to learn into a sequenced study plan with a goal test, prerequisites, ordered units with one primary resource each, spaced practice and retrieval, a project that proves the skill, and weekly time boxes that fit the learner's calendar; then track progress against it. Works for a technology, a research field, or a course. Use when starting to learn something for a thesis, a job, or a project, when a learning effort has stalled, or when the resource list is long and the order is unclear.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
